items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: my new badge in '77 and ID is under Sheriff Faught

ctx.x: I could be - and did become eventually as a citizen, I could legitimately recieve a regular commission in the sheriff's department of Ector County, Texas - and he set that up for me -- one of the bright happy lights in my life.

The sheriff then was Elwood Hill, and I got my new badge in 1977 and my ID -- no, I got the regular commission from Sheriff Hill and later on, the new sheriff, that lasted two or three years, Sheriff Faught -- and my new badge in '77 and ID is under Sheriff Faught. Since then, I have received my sheriff's commission.

I'm a little confused here, because I don't know what I gave -- said it as it is, I got a regular commission in the sheriff's department under Elwood Hill, and then as the sheriff's changed, the new badge, the one that I carry with me now, is from Elwood Faught, and of course, the sheriffs change after you have your new ID card.
